title: Concept: TLS verification disabled (dart) — review required
description: In dart, badCertificateCallbacks*= disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (default CA verification).
applicability: dart TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
